hypothesis: Declaring the normalized repeat count before the mask, while assigning it after all declarations, might change GC/1.3 graph-coloring priority without changing the retail instruction schedule: repeat count in r31 and mask in r29.
scope: One bounded source-shape experiment using unchanged canonical GC/1.3 settings and -use_lmw_stmw on.
source_change: Split u8 repeat_count = repeats into an earlier u8 repeat_count declaration and a later repeat_count = repeats assignment before the outer loop.
result: No codegen change. Canonical and relocation-strict JSON outputs are byte-identical before and after. The retained C remains size-exact and preserves all five relocation-bearing instructions, but GC/1.3 still assigns mask/repeat count to r29/r31 while retail uses r31/r29.
